insights.one_liner: Cefetra is a Rotterdam supplier of agricultural ingredients for animal feed, owned by Germany's BayWa; an IND sponsor with an English-language IT internship.

culture.text: About 59 people on LinkedIn, mostly in operations, finance and accounting.
Staff mostly studied economics, supply chain or business at Erasmus University, RSM, Nyenrode and Tilburg.
One of Europe's largest suppliers of ingredients for compound and aqua feed, pet food and energy markets.

open.text: Cefetra Group B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
